resources.string: Six tile puzzles: ice slides, rotating gravity, a limited tray and paths to open.
A little focus. A cascade of delight.
Six ways to play, woven into an endless journey. Every board brings a new rhythm.

Match identical tiles with a clear top and a free left or right side. Several copies of a pattern can be available: choose the two that uncover the tiles you need below. Removing the wrong copies can leave their partners trapped in the layers. Undo lets you change that choice.

Take uncovered tiles into a seven-slot tray. Three identical tiles clear together. Their third copy may be buried under other families: plan which incomplete sets you can hold while reaching it. The new puzzles require several occupied slots, so picking an extra family at the wrong moment can fill the tray. Undo lets you try another order.

Connect identical tiles through empty space with at most two right-angle turns; the outside border counts. When several copies are available, choose which partners to remove to open the right passage. A valid connection can leave the remaining copies without a route. Study the corners and shared passages before matching.

Connect identical tiles through empty space with at most two turns, including the outside border. After every pair, all remaining tiles fall in the indicated direction: down, left, up, right, then down again. Imagine where the tiles will land before choosing a pair: a fall can open a new route or trap the remaining matches.

On ice, you choose the direction, never the distance! Swipe a tile horizontally or vertically: it travels to the wall or stops just before the next tile, without pushing it. You can also select a tile and tap an empty cell in the desired direction. Highlighted cells show the possible stops.

Only one tile is active, highlighted in gold. Move it as many times as needed, then tap an identical tile on a clear straight line to commit the pair. If you choose another tile without matching, the previous tile returns to its dotted origin: that attempt is cancelled.

Most pairs need another family as a stopper. Matching a family too early can make the rest impossible: work out which stopping tiles you must keep. Undo lets you try a different order. Hint uses a complete solution to suggest the next selection, slide or pair.

Make ten with two numbers on a clear row or column: 1 + 9, 2 + 8, 3 + 7, 4 + 6 or 5 + 5. Suits do not matter. A number may have several possible partners. Choose sums that open a crossing row or column; using the wrong partner can isolate the remaining numbers.
A shared daily seed, playable offline. The bonus is awarded once per board date. No streak to maintain.

Mahjong board. Tap tiles to select them, then match according to the current mode.

YOUR CELESTIAL GARDEN
Six modes, Journey and Daily Gift each have their own save. All modes and helpers are available for free.

EARNING PEARLS
A victory earns 30 pearls, plus one per three starting tiles and a combo bonus. Each match raises the combo up to ×8; a mistake resets it. Half of the hundreds of points earned above base match points becomes bonus pearls, rounded down.

STAR DAYS
Each day, a featured mode doubles game pearls, including combo bonuses. On Saturday and Sunday, every mode doubles them! The bonus is fixed when a board starts, even if finished later. ×2 bonuses never stack. Every fifth victory gives +100 pearls. The daily board gives +40 once per date. These two gifts are not doubled. No daily streak to maintain.

TEXTURES AND PORCELAIN
Open Textures and porcelain in the menu, or Textures during a game. Two tabs let you separately choose and unlock tile materials and illustrations for values 1 and 2. Three designs are free in each tab. Buy the others in any order: the first costs 350 pearls, then the price rises after each purchase in the same tab. Pearls are spent; designs stay yours. No playtime requirement. Previously owned designs are kept.

No ads, real-money purchases, lives or deadlines.
%1$s. Tap Use to apply this design.
%1$s. Tap to see the price and unlock this design with pearls.

Each collection has its own material texture. Illustrations decorate only values 1 and 2; values 3 to 9 use countable central motifs. Choose any design: each purchase raises the next price, with no playtime requirement.
Victory: %1$d pearls and %2$d new porcelains. Tap a revealed tile to use its design.

THE THREE HELPERS
Undo goes back one move. Hint reveals a pair or a move in Slide. Shuffle rebuilds the board; in Triples it also clears the tray. All helpers are free and unlimited.

COMBOS AND PEARLS
Chain correct matches to raise the multiplier up to ×8. A wrong pair resets the combo, keeping earned points. Combo points earn extra pearls on victory. No speed is required. Undo restores previous points, so repeating a move cannot farm rewards.

YOUR PORCELAIN
Open the collection to buy a design or equip an owned one. Numbers show value; circle, diamond and star distinguish the three suits. Illustrations are decorative.

CHOOSE YOUR DESIGNS
From the menu, tap Textures and porcelain. During a game, tap Textures at the top.

TEXTURES
24 materials for tile backgrounds, colors and edges. Tap Use on an owned texture to apply it. Tap a locked card, then Unlock and use to buy it.

PORCELAIN
24 illustrations for values 1 and 2, paired with any texture you choose. Values 3 to 9 keep countable motifs. Switch tabs to choose or buy illustrations.

PEARLS
Three designs are free in each collection. Each collection has its own progressive prices: 350 pearls, then 350 + 100 × n + 12 × n² after n purchases in that tab. Both share your pearl balance. No playtime requirement.

Textures included in your previous porcelain purchases remain yours for free. Changing designs preserves every game and undo history.

THE PORCELAIN TRAIL
A journey alternating the six games. Finish a board to advance. Its save is independent of free-play modes.

Each stage earns pearls to buy your chosen designs. The ×2 bonus applies if the mode is featured or the board starts on a weekend. Helpers remain free.

DAILY GIFT
A new offline board each day, with 40 extra pearls on your first completion for that date. Its mode rotates between the six games.

An unfinished daily board stays saved even after midnight. Finish it whenever you like; the next board will use the current date. Replays still give normal rewards. There is no streak to lose and no deadline.
